download_model: download the profile expanded attention 128-truncation model for the LIGHT whoami dataset to the specified datapath
run_download: run the download function to fetch the profile expanded attention 128 model version v1.0 into the ParlAI model directory
review_download_function: review the download function that calls download_with_model_type with the profile_expanded_attention_128 model type and version v1.0
summarize_module: summarize the profile expanded attention 128 module which performs two rounds of expanded attention over character names and the self persona
test_download: test the download function by passing a datapath argument to verify the model downloads correctly to the light_whoami directory
